notes.title: Fortune Handlers Update Journal #2
notes.content:
🎲 Meet a new update for Fortune Handlers!

We continue working on the game and your feedback plays the most important role here! Based on your reviews we made a new patch:

- We added a new logic for environmental elements. Now you need to drag dice into them.
- There was an indication of the cooldown for the characters' abilities. In the new update, the player sees when the ability will be available.
- The priority of the wave of new enemies. There will not be the same waves of enemies one by one.
- Also, the enemies have a progress indication. It means that the player immediately sees when the dice are rolled and what options fell out to his characters as well as to their enemies.

I hope you will appreciate these changes and find the battles more breathtaking. 

Also, it would be nice if leave us a comment on what you want to know about Fortune Handlers development. I will share it with you!

notes.title: Fortune Handlers Update Journal #1
notes.content:
Hey! ːsteamhappyː

The last few weeks were hard, the team has been working on new features and visuals after your feedback, folks. We want to publish regular development logs to note the history of Fortune Handlers.

So today we are ready to release our first dev log. For the last two weeks, the team has been working on:
- Almost a new field configuration. It's now divided vertically.
- Moreover, there is also a global map and one dungeon for the battle. Now it's more about the future look of the game, and later there will be a map and you can choose dungeons.
- In addition, there is a start screen with the full description of the characters, and a new look of the battles and opponents.
- A new tutorial because of all these changes :D

That's all for now, but I will show you all the details in the next posts. If you want to see everything for yourself join our open test and follow the next Dev Log News!
